what.text: This page follows refugees from Croatia in all host countries combined, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 17207 refugees from Croatia.
Serbia and Kosovo hosts almost all of them, 95.9%, followed by Germany, Norway and the Netherlands.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Serb territory in Croatia from 1992 to 1995, with the Serbian Republic of Krajina and Serbian irregulars, at war level in some of those years.
The main years of displacement in the data, 1995 to 2004, begin in the last year of that conflict.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 1992 at 168570 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 353721, at the end of 1999, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country, reported to UNHCR.
